name: Governing board and its committees
authority: Source of all delegated authority; fiduciary oversight (UNB-GOV-001)
decisions_owned: Policy approval incl. board-delegated grant policy (OD-01)
segregation_constraints: Directors are not staff of the functions they oversee for audit/risk committee purposes (TVR-ORG-006 line to committee)
Board approves DoA; management cannot self-delegate
minimum_count: [A] ≥3 directors; exact number is state-law and bylaws dependent (UNB-GOV-006: thresholds/composition are assumptions)
scaling_driver: Fixed; does not scale with accounts

name: Accountable executive (sponsor officer)
authority: A4/A5 officer commands within DoA
decisions_owned: Degraded-mode/kill-switch activation with a second person (TVR-OPS-002)
segregation_constraints: Cannot be the only approver of own expense or related-party items (UNB-GOV-005)
Cannot publish a policy they authored (CTL-006)
can_be_outsourced: N — legal control stays with sponsor (§4966(d)(2))
scaling_driver: Fixed

name: Finance authority (controller/CFO function)
authority: Book of record, period certification, fee schedules, shortfall rule
segregation_constraints: Write-off approver ≠ break owner (SoD-7 in org §4)
Releaser ≠ reconciler (TVR-ORG-003): if this person releases payments, reconciliation must be owned elsewhere
scaling_driver: Step: finance-operations volume scales with contributions (exception share only)

name: Treasury release and payment-exception authority
authority: Payment release outside the automated gate; NotReceived resolution; destination-exception release
decisions_owned: NotReceived resolution by two independent approvers (UNB-RCN-WF-022)
segregation_constraints: ≠ payee profile approver for same payee (CTL-004/CTL-006)
≠ reconciler (TVR-ORG-003)
PA-2/NotReceived needs two approvers excluding the releaser (TVCTL-02)
can_be_outsourced: N for authority; Y for bank-portal operation under dual control
minimum_count: 2 distinct authorized holders (two-approver rules); see segregation section for pool size
scaling_driver: Linear with payment exceptions (returns, Unknowns), not with payments

name: Independent reconciler / financial reviewer
authority: Owns proof of cash, positions and break disposition outside the payment chain
segregation_constraints: Outside the payment chain (TVR-ORG-003, TVC-028)
Does not report to the releaser
can_be_outsourced: Y — an outsourced accounting firm satisfies independence at small scale (alternatives §8)
scaling_driver: Linear with break volume (break rate × transactions)

name: Charitable compliance decider
authority: A4 grant and vetting exceptions; ED/ER determinations; discretionary holds
segregation_constraints: Cannot decide a case they raised or prepared (SoD-4; RR-AIN-003-r1)
≠ sanctions decider on the same case (CTL-013)
Reconsideration of own decision forbidden
can_be_outsourced: Partial — evidence preparation outsourceable; decision by person named in sponsor DoA (SPD-ORG-002)
scaling_driver: Linear with exception volume = grants × e; e is the primary lever

name: Sanctions and fraud decider
authority: True-match disposition, blocking, OFAC reporting; restricted investigations
segregation_constraints: ≠ grant approver on same case (CTL-013 + inference, org §4)
Investigation access class restricted
can_be_outsourced: Partial — screening operations and investigation support outsourceable; true-match decision not
scaling_driver: Linear with potential matches and alerts

name: Payee/destination profile approver
authority: Approves new destinations and bank-detail changes outside automated evidence rules
decisions_owned: Destination activation where evidence is not automation-eligible (UNB-RCN-GRT-017)
segregation_constraints: ≠ releaser of payments to that payee (SoD-1, CTL-006)
minimum_count: 1 (any pool member not releasing to that payee)
scaling_driver: Linear with new payees and change requests

name: Gift acceptance authority
authority: Accepts or declines complex/noncash property on behalf of sponsor
segregation_constraints: Not the donor's advisor/related party (UNB-GOV-005)
can_be_outsourced: Partial — liquidation agents and appraisal outsourced; acceptance not
scaling_driver: Linear with complex gifts (≈2% of contributions [A])

name: Service and case owner
authority: Owns customer-requested assistance, commitments and complaint handling; no A3+ authority
segregation_constraints: Cannot decide reconsideration of a decision they influenced
Vendor staff hold no A3+ (UNB-XIN-CLM-008)
minimum_count: 1 + live-channel capacity per Erlang plan if live channels offered (UNB-XIN-SVC-008)
scaling_driver: Linear with human contacts (0.3/account/yr [A]) after proactive status

name: Independent reconsideration reviewer
authority: Fresh-look review of declined/held decisions
segregation_constraints: Independent of original decider (UNB-RCN-WF-018)
minimum_count: 1 (any authorized pool member other than the original decider)
scaling_driver: Linear with declines

name: Policy author
authority: Drafts sponsor configuration and policy versions
segregation_constraints: Author ≠ publisher (SoD-2, CTL-006)
AI may draft but cannot publish (OPS-007)
scaling_driver: Step with configuration change count

name: Policy publisher / independent approver
authority: Approves and publishes policy versions; platform-safety clearance separate (UNB-RCN-WF-021)
segregation_constraints: ≠ author of same version
scaling_driver: Step

name: Platform operator / incident commander
authority: Production change, release halts, incident command
segregation_constraints: Privileged access granted by someone else (SoD-6)
scaling_driver: Step (log of volume); not account-linear

name: Security officer / privileged-access granter
authority: Grants privileged access; security risk acceptance
segregation_constraints: Granter ≠ user (SoD-6)
Direct line to audit & risk committee (TVR-ORG-006)
scaling_driver: Fixed then step at scale

name: AI configuration owner
authority: Owns agent configurations, evaluation sets and promotion requests
segregation_constraints: ≠ model-risk sign-off (SoD-8)
Agents never fill either side of an SoD pair (TVR-ORG-007)
scaling_driver: Agent-family count, not account count (TVA-021 unsupported)

name: Model-risk sign-off
authority: Independent approval of AI configuration changes
segregation_constraints: ≠ AI configuration owner
scaling_driver: Change count

name: Counsel
authority: Legal determinations reserved to qualified lawyers
segregation_constraints: Privileged access class (UNB-XIN-CLM-007)
scaling_driver: Event-driven

name: Independent assurance (internal audit, STP sampling)
authority: Independent testing and sampling
decisions_owned: Control testing and deficiency closure (OPS-016, OPS-018)
segregation_constraints: Did not make the sampled decisions
Does not own the evidence ledger it audits (TVF-041)
scaling_driver: Sample plan size grows slowly (stratified sampling), not linearly

name: Investment oversight delegate
authority: Investment committee delegate; manager oversight
segregation_constraints: Not compensated by managers overseen (UNB-RCN-FIN-010)
can_be_outsourced: Partial — OCIO executes; sponsor committee retains oversight
scaling_driver: Fixed

name: Tax preparer (CPA)
authority: Prepares filings; officer signs
segregation_constraints: Preparer ≠ signing officer
scaling_driver: Fixed/annual

name: Relationship and partner owner
authority: Commercial relationships; no control authority
segregation_constraints: No A3+ decisions on own relationships' grants
scaling_driver: Step with partners and top-donor count

name: People administration
authority: HR, payroll, qualification records
segregation_constraints: Workforce feed changes cannot grant authority (UNB-XIN-ERP-005)
scaling_driver: Headcount

name: Vendor manager
authority: Vendor due diligence and outsourced-staff oversight
segregation_constraints: Not the business owner approving own vendor's exceptions
scaling_driver: Vendor count
